requirements.description: Provision one AWS VPC with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16.
requirements.expected_evidence: An aws_vpc resource with the specified CIDR.

requirements.description: Create two public subnets across two availability zones.
requirements.expected_evidence: Two public subnet resources in distinct availability zones, with public IP assignment enabled.

requirements.description: Create two private subnets across two availability zones.
requirements.expected_evidence: Two private subnet resources in distinct availability zones.

requirements.description: Allow public subnets to reach the internet through an Internet Gateway.
requirements.expected_evidence: An Internet Gateway, a public route table with a default route to the gateway, and public subnet associations.

requirements.description: Keep private subnets without a NAT gateway or default internet route.
requirements.expected_evidence: No NAT gateway and no default internet route in the private route tables.

requirements.description: Do not expose SSH or RDP to the entire IPv4 internet.
requirements.expected_evidence: No security group ingress rule allowing TCP port 22 or 3389 from 0.0.0.0/0.

requirements.description: Require review and human approval before applying infrastructure changes.
requirements.expected_evidence: A mandatory requirements review, blocking policy checks, and explicit approval before Terraform apply.
